name: Building Resources
description: Low-cost salvaged and reusable building materials, fixtures, and landscaping materials
fullDescription: Building Resources of San Francisco is a nonprofit 501(c)(3) reuse yard that sells low-cost salvaged and donated residential, commercial, and landscaping building materials.
whatTheyOffer:
- Salvaged lumber and wood products
- Doors, windows, and hardware
- Plumbing fixtures
- Kitchen and bathroom cabinets
- Tile and landscaping materials
- Reclaimed and vintage finds (stained glass, light fixtures, and more)
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the Building Resources yard (open 9 am-4:30 pm, 7 days a week)
2. Browse available materials in person or at shop.buildingresources.org
3. Pay low reuse prices
4. Transport materials yourself
5. Donate usable materials 9 am-3 pm
keywords: Building Resources, salvage, building materials, lumber, doors, windows, hardware, plumbing, electrical, cabinets, paint, reuse center, affordable, construction supplies
